# components/tree

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/tree/tree.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { Tree } from "@tundralibs/ui/tree"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/tree.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Tree`

```ts
Tree(props: TreeProps): Html
```

A WAI-ARIA tree view: nested `<ul>`s of `role="treeitem"` rows, each
parent with a chevron toggle. tree.js collapses the parents not marked
`expanded` on init (so without JS every branch is visible), toggles
them on click, and walks the tree from the keyboard (Arrow keys,
Home/End, Enter/Space, type-ahead). Ids derive from `id` and the
index path — stable across renders and swaps.

## Types

### `TreeNode`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `href` | `string` |  | A link — the row navigates. Without one the row only selects / toggles. |
| `icon` | `Html` |  | Leading icon (`Icon("folder")`); any `Html`. |
| `children` | `TreeNode[]` |  |  |
| `expanded` | `boolean` |  | Render this parent open. Without JS every parent is open. |
| `selected` | `boolean` |  | The current item (`aria-selected`, `aria-current` on a link). |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the `<li>`; a `class` merges. |

### `TreeProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: item ids derive from it (`<id>-0-2`). |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Accessible name of the tree. |
| `items` | `TreeNode[]` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the root `<ul>`; a `class` merges. |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A project's files

```ts
Tree({
  id: "files",
  label: "Files",
  items: [
    {
      label: "src",
      icon: Icon("folder", { size: 16 }),
      expanded: true,
      children: [
        { label: "app.ts", icon: Icon("file", { size: 16 }), href: "/files/src/app.ts", selected: true },
        { label: "routes.ts", icon: Icon("file", { size: 16 }), href: "/files/src/routes.ts" },
      ],
    },
    { label: "README.md", icon: Icon("file", { size: 16 }), href: "/files/README.md" },
  ],
})
```

```html

      <button type="button" class="tree__toggle" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Toggle" aria-controls="files-0-group" data-tree-toggle>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/tree/tree.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.js`, `.tree`, `.tree__group`, `.tree__icon`, `.tree__item`, `.tree__item--parent`, `.tree__item--selected`, `.tree__label`, `.tree__link`, `.tree__row`, `.tree__spacer`, `.tree__text`, `.tree__toggle`

## Behaviour

`components/tree/tree.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-tree`, `data-tree-expanded`, `data-tree-ready`, `data-tree-toggle`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
